script:
Gym people, quick question: how many single socks are in your gym bag right now?
Mine had four. Not one pair.
Now I wear SockLock. There's a tiny magnet in each cuff.
After the workout I click them together, they go in the wash as a pair and come out as a pair.
My gym bag finally makes sense.
Five pairs for $29, then a new box every three months.
Take the quiz to get your size.
